"""Main-only isolated free/contrib-llvm builds and actual shared-helper CPU checks."""
from pathlib import Path
import fcntl
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json

B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
G = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata')
W = G / '.worktree/perf-native-copy-cohorts-qualified-20261012'
WT = G / '.worktree/diag-native-copy-queue-qualified-20261013'
P = B / 'main-prefill-native-copy-queue-source-v2'
X = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/MistVVK/XeStrata/.worktree/fix-xestrata-e32-host-handoff-20261011')
T, L = X / '.tools/intel-llvm-v711/install', X / '.lint'
O = B / 'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
assert hashlib.sha256(O.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == 'a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'
assert hashlib.sha256((P / 'manifest.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest() == 'c0cde748fe13e4737b08ae7fe88fe3d533a37bba794196ae93b2ba5ac5ffd11d'
assert hashlib.sha256((P / 'changes.patch').read_bytes()).hexdigest() == 'e231e41895a0e94e844f3884d97b8805191b461f952baf23ed7a120fe985589c'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('native_copy_build_owner', O)
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)
ENV = dict(PATH=f'{T}/bin:{L}/venv/bin:{L}/bin:/usr/bin:/bin', HOME='/home/yayoi',
           LANG='C.UTF-8', LC_ALL='C.UTF-8', PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1',
           LD_LIBRARY_PATH=f'{T}/lib:/opt/intel/oneapi/mkl/2026.1/lib',
           MKLROOT='/opt/intel/oneapi/mkl/2026.1', OMP_NUM_THREADS='1',
           GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT='0', GIT_SSH_COMMAND='ssh -oBatchMode=yes')
prior_env = json.loads((B / 'latest-update-main-finalization-host-root-v8/record.json').read_text())['environment']
for key in ['RUBYLIB', 'GEM_PATH']:
    ENV[key] = prior_env[key]


def dump(path, value):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2) + '\n')


with (B / 'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    out = B / 'main-native-copy-queue-build-root-v1'
    assert not out.exists() and not WT.exists()
    out.mkdir()
    r = dict(active=True, passed=False, complete=False, commands=[], evidence={},
             environment=ENV, worktree=str(WT), branch='diag/native-copy-queue-qualified-20261013',
             main_reviewed=True, model_executed=False, gpu_executed=False, adopted=False,
             owner_sha256=m.sha(O), packet_manifest_sha256=m.sha(P / 'manifest.json'),
             patch_sha256=m.sha(P / 'changes.patch'))

    def save():
        dump(out / 'record.json', r)

    owner = m.Owner(out / 'commands', save)
    r['commands'] = owner.commands

    def run(label, argv, cwd=WT, allowed=(0,), env=None, wall=1200, cpu=20000, rss=24 << 30):
        print('OWNED BUILD/CHECK ' + label, flush=True)
        c, so, se = owner.run(label, argv, env or ENV, cwd, wall=wall, cpu=cpu,
                             rss_cap=rss, text_cap=32 << 20, total_cap=64 << 20)
        text_out, text_err = so.read_text(), se.read_text()
        r['evidence'][label] = dict(stdout=text_out, stderr=text_err)
        save()
        assert m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] in allowed, label
        return text_out, text_err, c

    def configure(mode, source=WT, folder=None, sanitize=False):
        folder = folder or source / 'build' / mode
        argv = ['/usr/bin/cmake', '-S', str(source), '-B', str(folder), '-G', 'Ninja',
                '-DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release', f'-DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER={T}/bin/clang++',
                f'-DCMAKE_C_COMPILER={T}/bin/clang', '-DSTRATA_LICENSE=' + ('contrib' if mode == 'contrib-llvm' else 'free'),
                '-DSTRATA_ENABLE_XE=ON', '-DSTRATA_CUDA_ARCHS=', '-DSTRATA_HIP_ARCHS=',
                '-DSTRATA_ONEMKL=' + ('ON' if mode == 'contrib-llvm' else 'OFF'),
                '-DSTRATA_PORTABLE=OFF', '-DSTRATA_BUILD_TESTS=ON', '-DSTRATA_WERROR=ON',
                '-DSTRATA_GGML_DIR=/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/.worktree/dep-ggml-3cf-xe-e32-20261011',
                '-DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON']
        if mode == 'contrib-llvm':
            argv += ['-DSTRATA_ONEMATH_SOURCE=file:///home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata/.worktree/sync-xe-v0143-nonfinite-20261012/build/contrib-llvm/_deps/strata_onemath-subbuild/strata_onemath-populate-prefix/src/xestrata-3.tar.gz',
                     '-DMKL_ROOT=/opt/intel/oneapi/mkl/2026.1']
        if sanitize:
            argv += ['-DSTRATA_SANITIZE=address,undefined']
        run('configure-' + folder.name, argv, source)
        return folder

    def cpu_checks(folder, label, env):
        for value in [None, '0', '1', '01', '1 ']:
            current = dict(env)
            if value is not None:
                current['STRATA_COPY_ENGINE'] = value
            stdout, stderr, command = run(label + '-policy-' + repr(value), [str(folder / 'copy_stream_policy_test')],
                                        env=current, wall=30, cpu=60, rss=512 << 20)
            assert stdout.strip() == 'PASS exact opt-in and frozen policy' and not stderr
        for mode in ['success', 'pre-import', 'import-before', 'import-after', 'insertion',
                     'drain-error', 'drain-throw', 'list-error', 'list-throw', 'loader-error']:
            expected = 0 if mode in ['success', 'pre-import'] else 1
            so, se, command = run(label + '-lifetime-' + mode, [str(folder / 'native_copy_lifetime_test'), mode],
                                  allowed=(expected,), env=env, wall=30, cpu=60, rss=512 << 20)
            lines = so.splitlines()
            if expected == 0:
                assert not se and lines[-3:] == ['RELEASE native', 'RELEASE loader', 'UNWIND outer']
                if mode == 'success':
                    assert lines.index('DRAIN checked') < lines.index('RELEASE borrower') < lines.index('RELEASE native')
                else:
                    assert 'FALLBACK pre-import only' in lines and 'IMPORT attempted' not in lines
            else:
                assert 'terminating without releasing in-flight allocations' in se and 'UNWIND outer' not in lines
                assert 'RELEASE loader' not in lines
                if mode in ['import-before', 'import-after', 'insertion', 'drain-error', 'drain-throw']:
                    assert not any(line.startswith('RELEASE') for line in lines)
                elif mode in ['list-error', 'list-throw']:
                    assert 'RELEASE borrower' in lines and 'RELEASE native' not in lines
                else:
                    assert 'RELEASE borrower' in lines and 'RELEASE native' in lines

    try:
        pub = json.loads((B / 'main-long-decode128-repeat-publication-root-v1/record.json').read_text())
        assert pub['passed'] and pub['complete'] and not pub['active']
        head, _, _ = run('base-head', ['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], W, wall=30)
        assert head.strip() == pub['commit']
        r['base_commit'] = head.strip()
        status, _, _ = run('base-status', ['git', 'status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all'], W, wall=30)
        assert not status.strip()
        root_branch, _, _ = run('root-branch', ['git', 'symbolic-ref', '--short', 'HEAD'], G, wall=30)
        assert root_branch.strip() == 'main'
        run('worktree-list', ['git', 'worktree', 'list', '--porcelain'], W, wall=30)
        run('create-isolated-worktree', ['git', 'worktree', 'add', '-b', r['branch'], str(WT), r['base_commit']], W, wall=60)
        manifest = json.loads((P / 'manifest.json').read_text())
        for entry in manifest['source_files']:
            target = WT / entry['path']
            assert m.sha(target) == entry['before_sha256'] if entry['before_sha256'] else not target.exists()
        run('patch-check', ['git', 'apply', '--check', str(P / 'changes.patch')], wall=30)
        run('apply-source', ['git', 'apply', str(P / 'changes.patch')], wall=30)
        for entry in manifest['source_files']:
            assert m.sha(WT / entry['path']) == entry['after_sha256']
        r['source_pins'] = {entry['path']: m.sha(WT / entry['path']) for entry in manifest['source_files']}
        r['source_patch_applied_exactly'] = True
        run('source-diff-check', ['git', 'diff', '--check'], wall=30)
        for mode in ['free', 'contrib-llvm']:
            folder = configure(mode)
            run('build-' + mode, ['/usr/bin/cmake', '--build', str(folder), '--parallel', '4', '--target',
                                  'strata', 'native_copy_stream_test', 'copy_stream_policy_test', 'native_copy_lifetime_test'])
            cpu_checks(folder, mode, ENV)
            r.setdefault('binaries', {})[mode] = {name: dict(path=str(folder / name), sha256=m.sha(folder / name))
                for name in ['strata', 'native_copy_stream_test', 'copy_stream_policy_test', 'native_copy_lifetime_test']}
            save()
        folder = configure('free', folder=WT / 'build/free-asan', sanitize=True)
        run('build-host-asan', ['/usr/bin/cmake', '--build', str(folder), '--parallel', '4', '--target',
                                'copy_stream_policy_test', 'native_copy_lifetime_test'])
        sanitized = dict(ENV, ASAN_OPTIONS='detect_leaks=1:halt_on_error=1', UBSAN_OPTIONS='halt_on_error=1:print_stacktrace=1')
        cpu_checks(folder, 'free-asan', sanitized)
        r.update(passed=True, complete=True, cpu_shared_lifetime_checks_passed=True,
                 free_contrib_llvm_built=True, asan_ubsan_cpu_passed=True, lints_qualified=False,
                 native_import_runtime_qualified=False, next_step='Main baseline/new lints and fresh qualified tinyGPU fixture before model admission')
    except BaseException as error:
        r['error'] = repr(error)
    finally:
        r.update(active=owner.active is not None, finished_utc=m.utc())
        save()
    print(json.dumps({k: r.get(k) for k in ['passed', 'error', 'worktree', 'free_contrib_llvm_built', 'asan_ubsan_cpu_passed']}))
    raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
